The question doesn't say GAAP or adjusted. The range centred near 0.5 points to adjusted, but GAAP gets 30% weight. calls.reconciliation: Main factual dispute: which EPS counts. It can't be settled because the criteria are blank. The range centred near 0.5 and aggregator convention favour adjusted, so I weight 70/30. Bitcoin treatment is settled by the Q2 SEC filing Run 1 cites, which shows digital-asset gains and losses as a GAAP-to-adjusted reconciling item. So Run 3's +0.08 boost to adjusted is dropped and bitcoin is applied to GAAP only (BTC holding of ~11.5k not verified). The GAAP gap is rebuilt from components: stock-based pay -0.28, bitcoin +0.07, SpaceX mark -0.03, giving ~0.19 GAAP. Hudson Labs' 0.26 GAAP consensus is discounted because Run 2 found it internally inconsistent. The adjusted centre is a judgment call: Q2 volumes ≈ Q3 volumes and Q2 printed 0.33, so I go modestly below consensus at 0.41, between Runs 2 and 3. Run 1's reference-class framing is broadly carried forward, with a wider GAAP-component SD.
